messages:
infra-pager: ALERT: node/gpu-07 ephemeral storage > 92% (inode pressure). Pod eviction threshold crossed. Affected pods: rtd-serv-7, modelcache-2, logger-fluentd-8. Pager: P0 - potential customer impact.
Alex R.: I’m seeing repeated OOMKilled + CUDA errors in rtd-serv logs after the modelcache pod gets evicted. stack: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` then container restart loop.
Priya S.: Copy. Can someone confirm disk usage breakdown? `kubectl exec` into node or `ssh`?
Danny M.: quick du on node: `/var/lib/kubelet/pods/*/volumes/*/modelcache` shows a runaway folder: `/var/lib/kubelet/pods/.../modelcache/data` ~ 420G. Logs folder `/var/log/containers` also ~120G, lots of rotated .log. inode count near exhaustion.
Alex R.: That modelcache directory should be on ephemeral scratch but it’s grown because older checkpoints not being GC'd — garbage collector crashed earlier (stacktrace in modelcache logs). When modelcache is gone, rtd-serv tries to reload heavy weights into GPU, hits OOM/CUDA because KV cache warmup parallelism spikes.
Priya S.: Customer impact: frontend 503s for some customers hitting large-qa endpoint. CDN retries masking some errors. Telemetry: 5% error rate spike, elevated tail latency. Flagging for pager.
oncall-bot: oncall shift notification: @Priya S. is the primary. If you need handoff, run `#incident handoff` and mention night-oncall.
Priya S.: Ok, mitigation plan: 1) cordon gpu-07, 2) drain non-critical pods (logger-fluentd-*), 3) try to free space by removing stale modelcache snapshots, 4) reduce rtd-serv concurrency to prevent GPU OOM, 5) temporary log level -> warn.
Danny M.: Running: `kubectl cordon gpu-07 && kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m` — will evict/relocate surviving pods. Starting now.
Alex R.: Before we drain, patch modelcache to stop creating new checkpoints: `kubectl -n infra patch deployment/modelcache --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"modelcache","env":[{"name":"CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL","value":"0"}]}]}}}}'`
Danny M.: Done. Modelcache stopped new snapshots. I’m ssh'ing to node to rm stale folders: `sudo rm -rf /var/lib/kubelet/pods/.../modelcache/data/checkpoints/*` — deleting oldest 300G.
infra-pager: Note: deleting files may cause transient 429s while modelcache rebuilds.
Priya S.: Good. Also scale down rtd-serv replicas to 1 to reduce simultaneous cache loads: `kubectl scale deploy rtd-serv --replicas=1 -n serving`
Alex R.: Patch rolling restart to reduce parallel model loads: `kubectl set env deploy/rtd-serv MAX_CACHE_PREFETCH=1 -n serving`
ops-bot: Detected pattern: containers reporting `OOMKilled` due to memory spike after cache miss. Suggested temp mitigation: disable prefetch in runtime config and set `--cache-dir=/mnt/ssd` where /mnt/ssd is larger (needs node-level PV).
Priya S.: We can't remount now. For short term: restart the runtime with `--max-token-batch=16` to reduce memory. I'll apply config change.
Danny M.: Node freed ~360G, inode count recovered. Starting uncordon/drain complete re-schedule.
Alex R.: After restart, we're still seeing occasional `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` but much less. Watch telemetry.
Priya S.: Customer impact update: errors down to 0.8%, tail latency back to normal for most tenants, 2 high-traffic customers still seeing intermittent 503s — routing them to fallback model variants.
infra-pager: Incident note: created runbook link https://redwood.internal/incidents/3755001234 for postmortem data.
Priya S.: Handoff: If anyone needs to follow up overnight, assign to night-oncall and add TODO: 1) permanent GC fix for modelcache, 2) move cache off kubelet localdir (hostPath -> PV with eviction protection), 3) logrotate aggressive retention, 4) add node-level alert for inode pressure earlier.
Danny M.: I’ll open a PR to add a GC watchdog and tune `CHECKPOINT_RETENTION=3`.
Alex R.: Also propose runtime change to tolerate missing cache: fall back to smaller model variant without full GPU KV warmup. Will draft RFC.
oncall-bot: incident resolved (mitigated). Please fill incident template in the runbook and tag `postmortem-needed` if major customer impact. :white_check_mark:
Priya S.: Thanks team. Adding follow-ups to the incident ticket.
Alex R.: leaving notes: affected nodes: gpu-07, pods evicted: modelcache-2, rtd-serv-7, logger-fluentd-8; freed ~360G; root cause: modelcache GC crash -> runaway checkpoint accumulation -> inode/disk pressure -> pod eviction -> cache misses causing concurrent GPU memory spikes -> CUDA OOMs and restarts.
Priya S.: End of thread.
